channel.description: Recent content in Publications on Berkcan Kapusuzoglu

item.title: Critique-Guided Distillation for Robust Reasoning via Refinement
item.description: Critique-Guided Distillation trains a student to refine flawed responses using teacher critiques as training-only supervision, without requiring critiques at inference.

item.title: When Load-Balancing Goes Too Far: Expert Pruning in Over-Dispersed Mixture-of-Experts Models
item.description: When load balancing spreads routing too uniformly across experts, router scores become less useful for deciding which experts to prune. Domain-aware score allocation accounts for which capabilities each expert supports.

item.title: Structured Thoughts for Improved Reasoning and Context Pruning
item.description: Structured Thoughts organizes reasoning into alternating exploration and outcome blocks, and studies pruning exploratory text to reduce context use.

item.title: Your Model Diversity, Not Method, Determines Reasoning Strategy
item.description: This work argues that reasoning strategies should account for a model’s diversity profile and formalizes when depth refinement can outperform parallel sampling.

item.title: SPEAR-MM: Selective Parameter Evaluation and Restoration via Model Merging for Efficient Financial LLM Adaptation
item.description: SPEAR-MM uses post-hoc layer evaluation and spherical interpolation merging to preserve general capabilities during financial-domain adaptation of language models.

item.title: Optimizing Reasoning Efficiency through Prompt Difficulty Prediction
item.description: This work trains lightweight predictors from model representations to estimate prompt difficulty or correctness and route each problem to a suitably sized reasoning model.

item.title: StructMoE: Structured Mixture of Experts Using Low Rank Experts
item.description: This paper introduces StructMoE, which augments mixture-of-experts models with dynamic capacity using structured low-rank experts.

item.title: Multi-Level Bayesian Calibration of a Multi-Component Dynamic System Model
item.description: This paper proposes multi-level Bayesian calibration for time-dependent multi-component systems using heterogeneous measurements.

item.title: Adaptive surrogate modeling for high-dimensional spatio-temporal output
item.description: This paper develops adaptive surrogate modeling for systems with high-dimensional spatio-temporal outputs.

item.title: Dimension reduction for efficient surrogate modeling in high-dimensional applications
item.description: This report studies efficient surrogate modeling for aerospace analyses with high-dimensional inputs and spatio-temporal outputs.

item.title: Multi-objective optimization under uncertainty of part quality in fused filament fabrication
item.description: This work develops data-driven multi-objective optimization under uncertainty for geometric accuracy and filament bond quality in fused filament fabrication.

item.title: Information fusion and machine learning for sensitivity analysis using physics knowledge and experimental data
item.description: This paper studies global sensitivity analysis when both physics-based models and experimental observations are available.

item.title: Digital twin approach for damage-tolerant mission planning under uncertainty
item.description: This article develops digital-twin-based mission planning for mechanical systems subject to damage-tolerance requirements.

item.title: Digital twin approach for intelligent operation planning and health management of mechanical systems
item.description: This paper presents a digital-twin methodology for operation planning and health management of mechanical systems under uncertainty.

item.title: Discrete eigenseparation-based reduced order homogenization method for failure modeling of composite materials
item.description: This paper presents a reduced-order computational homogenization method for failure analysis of composite materials.

item.title: Fatigue Crack Growth Diagnosis and Prognosis for Damage-Adaptive Operation of Mechanical Systems
item.description: This paper describes diagnosis and prognosis of fatigue-crack growth for damage-adaptive operation of mechanical systems.

item.title: Physics-informed and hybrid machine learning in additive manufacturing: application to fused filament fabrication
item.description: This article studies physics-informed and hybrid machine-learning strategies for predicting bond quality and porosity in fused filament fabrication. It compares ways to incorporate physical constraints, simulation outputs, and simulation-based pretraining.

item.title: Process Optimization under Uncertainty for Improving the Bond Quality of Polymer Filaments in Fused Filament Fabrication
item.description: This legacy route refers to the same published article represented by the canonical 2020 publication record.

item.title: Process Optimization Under Uncertainty for Improving the Bond Quality of Polymer Filaments in Fused Filament Fabrication
item.description: This paper develops a framework to optimize fused-filament-fabrication parameters for polymer-filament bond quality while accounting for uncertainty in the underlying models.

item.title: Resilience-enhancing operations of aerostructural systems under uncertainty: a digital twin approach
item.description: This work examines a digital-twin approach to resilience-enhancing operation planning for aerostructural systems under uncertainty.
